input.subject: [E19] Xbox Not Turning On
input.body: Hey ByteMart, this is very disappointing. I received my Xbox Series S today, and although the box and console have no visible scratches or damage, the console does not turn on. I initially thought it might be an issue with the power cord, so I borrowed my friend's Xbox Series S power cord, but the console still does not turn on and there are no lights. Please help me with a replacement or suitable resolution. Order No: BM834853.
